review_intro: Claude Fable 5.2 reviewed the work plan, drawing findings and finished Unity images, including a follow-up of two recaptured views. Its verdict is ready for headset review of this scoped revision. It identified evidence gaps and non-blocking visual limitations, recorded below. This is not acceptance of every checklist item or engineering design.
latest_note: Architectural detail pass 0.4.6: views 71–83 show the new work. Views 1–70 retain their earlier numbers. Three niches, the laundry bulkhead, wet finishes/accessories and above-ground drainage are included. Specific drawing conflicts remain open.

items.title: Laundry bulkhead
items.response: 340mm dimension chain closes the 2740mm ceiling and meets cupboard tops at 2400. The conflicting 300mm label and illustrative 380mm projection remain recorded.

items.title: Three recessed shower niches
items.response: Ensuite 1000x450, upper bathroom 900x450 and Bath2 600x450. Sills 1200mm above tile; 60mm recess depth is illustrative. 27 back rays pass and opposite wall linings are preserved.

items.title: Niche framing
items.response: Generated studs/noggins are explicitly trimmed around openings with visible jambs, heads and sills. Every changed member is recorded. Member sizes/connections and concealed mixer plumbing require coordination.

items.title: Wet-room tiles and accessories
items.response: Full-height finishes completed for powder, ensuite/WC and Bath2. Upper bathroom tiles retained. Seven mounted accessories added. Claude corrected the upper WC to painted walls with 100mm tiled skirting on every wall.

items.title: Downpipes, rainheads and spreaders
items.response: Eight downpipes, three rainheads, two spreaders, three 300x300x150 sumps and garage/porch channels. All 13 outlets are physically open. No new drainage intersects retained timber/steel or projects across scheduled glazing.

items.title: DP06 beside ensuite window
items.response: The two floor drawings disagree. A straight drop at either plotted position crosses W07 or W18 in the current model. The sloping offset between storeys clears both; sheet10 does not draw a route.

items.title: Theatre and global level conflicts
items.response: Theatre platform height/high side, 2340 door versus bulkhead soffit, W08 head junction, powder stair soffit and retained floor/ceiling/parapet datums remain unresolved. No platform height has been invented.

items.title: Check scope
items.response: The 309-item register retains individual statuses and historical evidence. These targeted repairs and regression checks do not certify every architectural/engineering element or headset comfort.

items.title: Claude finished-work review
items.response: No blocking defect was substantiated. Gutter/framing views were recaptured and missing reports supplied. The garage roof still lacks surface detail, framing is layered, and illustrative niche assumptions are labelled in the report/gallery rather than inside the app. Separate saved-mesh checks subsequently confirmed 16 connected pipe/scupper routes and recorded the 12 new trimmer members.
